chunks.section: Handling Common Prospect Objections › What happens if I'm not satisfied with the shortlist presented?
chunks.text:
"What happens if I'm not satisfied with the shortlist presented?"
Response: Nexova offers one additional round of search at no cost if none
of the candidates in the initial shortlist are acceptable, provided the
client has given specific feedback on why they didn't fit.

If, 4 weeks into an executive search, no qualified candidate has been
presented, the assigned consultant must escalate the case to Javier Almeida
(Operations Manager) and proactively notify the client with an action plan.

output.answer:
Ticket #96 "Mobile app crashes on iOS 17 after update" is **Open**. Category: Technical failure; origin: Customer; branch: Central. Opened 2024-01-28, last updated 2024-01-28.

Great question, and it's a fair one to have. Nobody wants to invest weeks and come up empty. Here's how we handle that scenario.

First, if none of the candidates in the initial shortlist are acceptable, we'll go back to the market and run one additional round of search for you at no cost. That's our standard process. The one condition is that we need your specific feedback on why those candidates didn't fit, so we can refine the profile and make the next round count.

Second, to keep things transparent, we have a built-in checkpoint. If we're 4 weeks into an executive search and still haven't presented a qualified candidate, our assigned consultant is required to escalate the case to our Operations Manager, Javier Almeida. At that point, we proactively reach out to you with a clear action plan to get things back on track.

So you're never left wondering where things stand, and you always have a clear path forward. Does that address your concern? If you'd like, we can set up a quick call to walk through the process in more detail and see if we're a good fit for your current opening.
